description: Fetch the status and, when finished, the report for a runId returned by check_site_speed, check_ai_visibility, check_local_rank, or start_audit. If the run is still going, this call waits up to about 40 seconds for it to finish before answering. If status is still running after that, wait pollAfterSeconds, then call again with the same runId. Reads only; starts nothing.

runId.description: The runId returned by an async tool.

name: get_audit_report
title: Get checkup results
